variants.prompt: Seated on a plush, velvet chaise in a dimly lit, opulent penthouse suite, the regal beauty wears a sheer, black lace corset that hugs her every curve, leaving her porcelain skin almost entirely exposed. She props one long leg up on the armrest, the other dangling seductively as she regards the viewer through heavy, languid lids. Her full lips are parted in a sensual, inviting smile that seems to beckon the viewer closer.
